newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to go on holiday on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to go on holiday on Monday.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin will go on holiday on Monday to a lakeside state residence in the northwestern Russian region of Karelia, the Kremlin said on Thursday.

The presidential press service said Yeltsin, 66, would spend part of his vacation in the Shuyskaya Chupa residence by a lake near Petrozavodsk, 180 km (112 miles) from the border with Finland. It did not say how long he would be away.
